xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4245: Conversation titles and About summaries describe only the latest request, not what's still in context

plan.title: Conversation titles and About summaries describe only the latest request, not what's still in context
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: In long Claude Code conversations the AI title and About summary describe only the latest request. The parser drops the compaction summary record (isSystemInjection hides it), keeps no summary text, and the serializer sends only a head+tail excerpt, while the title prompt tells the model to favor the most recent direction. Conversation 2878 (83 MB, four compactions) was retitled after its last topic only.
narratives.Proposal: Record the latest isCompactSummary record on the Claude parse result (latestCompactSummary, threaded through ParseState so the >10 MB chunk loop and incremental reads keep it), carry it through the getCachedMessages cache, and add a summary-aware mode to serializeConversationTranscript: the summary goes first under a fixed label, followed only by turns after it (About: up to 14,000 summary chars + recent turns to 24,000; title: 4,000 summary chars + 3,500 recent chars). Rewrite the title prompt to name the overall scope still in context, add summary guidance to the About prompt, derive the fallback title from the summary's Primary Request section, and pass the summary from auto refine, retitle and About. Without a summary, output stays byte-identical.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not change what the chat view shows: the compaction summary stays out of `messages`.
- Do not add summary support for Codex, OpenCode/ACP, Pi, ohmypi, Kimi or Muse transcripts; they keep today's head+tail behavior.
- Do not change summarizeFirstMessageTitle, the admin title backfill (routes/admin.ts), the refine cadence, or the title model.
- Do not add latestCompactSummary to any RPC/wire schema in @overdeck/contracts or to any WebSocket payload.
- Do not use earlier (non-latest) compaction summaries.
- Do not modify titleTranscriptWindow.
- Do not call retitleConversation or write any conversation title during the conversation 2878 manual check.
- Do not add tests to src/dashboard/server/services/__tests__/conversation-service.test.ts (over the 1,000-line ceiling).

autoDecisions.summary: latestCompactSummary is a ParseState field; each parse returns foundInThisRead ?? priorState.latestCompactSummary.
autoDecisions.rationale: The motivating 83 MB transcript goes through parseEntireConversation's 10 MB chunk loop, which returns {...last}; a per-chunk-only field would be lost whenever the summary is not in the last chunk. Threading through ParseState makes the chunk loop and incremental reads correct by construction.

autoDecisions.summary: serializeConversationTranscript takes { compactSummary, purpose: 'about' | 'title' } instead of re-parsing markers out of a string in titleTranscriptWindow.
autoDecisions.rationale: A title-purpose transcript with a summary is at most ~7,700 chars, so titleTranscriptWindow (8,000) passes it through unchanged and needs no marker parsing; a summary of this very work would quote any marker and break string splitting.

autoDecisions.summary: Strip the fixed continuation preamble paragraph from the summary before serializing.
autoDecisions.rationale: It carries no topic information, and removing it makes the kept text start at 'Summary:\n1. Primary Request and Intent:', which the title head budget and fallback rely on.

autoDecisions.summary: Messages without a sequence are kept after the summary.
autoDecisions.rationale: They cannot be placed relative to the summary; the Claude parser always sets sequence, so this only affects synthetic input.

autoDecisions.summary: The structural TranscriptCompactSummary type lives in transcript-summary.ts; the parser's CompactSummaryRecord lives in conversation/types.ts; nothing goes into @overdeck/contracts.
autoDecisions.rationale: transcript-summary.ts is documented as a pure leaf, and contracts holds RPC schemas that must not grow a 14 KB server-only field.
The prompt is built inside functions that spawn claude; exporting the builders makes the 'no longer contains favor the most recent direction' criterion a unit assertion.

autoDecisions.summary: The conversation 2878 manual check uses a gitignored .tmp scratch script that prints the title and About; it never calls retitleConversation.
autoDecisions.rationale: Retitling would overwrite the operator's live conversation title with title_source 'ai-explicit'; printing proves the behavior without that side effect. Fallback when tsx cannot import: document post-deploy curl/UI steps in the PR.

autoDecisions.summary: New parser and cache tests go in new files.
autoDecisions.rationale: conversation-service.test.ts is 1,398 lines, over the 1,000-line ceiling enforced by scripts/lint-file-size.sh.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1. In conversation/types.ts add the exported CompactSummaryRecord {text, sequence, uuid?, timestamp?}, add latestCompactSummary?: CompactSummaryRecord to ParseResult and ParseState, and isCompactSummary?: boolean to JsonlEntry. In parser.ts initialize `let latestCompactSummary = priorState?.latestCompactSummary` next to permissionMode; in the user branch, when entry.isCompactSummary === true, set it from string content or joined text blocks (non-blank only) with sequence = lineSequence; leave the renderableUserText handling untouched. Return it from the main return object and the missing-file early return (priorState value); the truncation early return does not carry it. In parseEntireConversation add `latestCompactSummary: result.latestCompactSummary` to the priorState literal. Write the new test file with real temp files (mkdtempSync under os.tmpdir(), cleaned in afterEach).

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-3 exactly. Add ABOUT_SUMMARY_BUDGET=14_000, TITLE_SUMMARY_BUDGET=4_000, TITLE_RECENT_BUDGET=3_500, exported COMPACT_SUMMARY_LABEL='Summary of earlier context (written when the conversation was compacted):', RECENT_TURNS_LABEL='Recent turns after the summary:', RECENT_OMITTED_MARKER='[… earlier turns after the summary omitted for length …]', CONTINUATION_PREAMBLE_PREFIX. Widen TranscriptMessage to Pick<ChatMessage,'role'|'text'|'sequence'>, export TranscriptCompactSummary {text; sequence} and SerializeTranscriptOptions {compactSummary?; purpose?: 'about'|'title'}. Extract renderTurns() from the existing filter+map, keep the no-summary path byte-identical, and implement the summary path from the PRD pseudo-code (strip preamble up to first blank line, cap summary with slice+'…', keep only messages with sequence undefined or > summary.sequence, recent budget = TITLE_RECENT_BUDGET for title or TRANSCRIPT_BUDGET minus summary section length for about, prefix RECENT_OMITTED_MARKER when trimmed). Update the function doc comment.
